description: Zbiór danych przestrzennych dla studium uwarunkowań i kierunków zagospodarowania przestrzennego gminy Burzenin is a dataset listed in Geo-System metadata catalogue, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by burzenin.e-mapa.net. Spatial data set for the study of conditions and directions of spatial development in the municipality of Burzenin. Register kept by the Municipality of Burzenin on the basis of the Regulation of the Ministry of Regional Development on spatial data sets and metadata in the field of spatial planning. Coverage: PL. The portal shows the English title as "Spatial data set for the study of conditions and directions of spatial development in the municipality of Burzenin" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include PlannedLandUse. The listing shows 4 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/metadata-codelist/ConditionsApplyingToAccessAndUse/noConditionsApply). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-podgik.
